fact: Central Equatoria State government launched a Digital Land Registry for Juba and surroundings on 11 August 2023, with the governor saying it would be extended to Yei, Terekeka, possibly Kajo-Keji and Kaya; the article does not say transactions are processed on it.
FAO issued a request for proposal on 23 September 2025, closing 30 October 2025, for consultancy services to develop a Land Information System for South Sudan.
system: Land Information System (LIS) for South Sudan
